messages.en:
{07 14 00}The fireworks{01 00 00 0a 00} have started!
Wahooooo!!

{07 0d 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}I've been looking forward to
this{01 00 00 0a 00} since I woke up this
morning,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Ilutulestik{01 00 00 0a 00} on alanud!
Juhhuuu!!

{07 0d 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Olen seda oodanud{01 00 00 0a 00}
sellest ajast, kui täna
hommikul ärkasin,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}{01 08 00}BOOM!


{07 0a 00}The fireworks have finally
begun! {01 00 00 0a 00}That noise just
screams {01 00 00 0a 00}{01 08 00}"SUMMER!!!" to me.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{01 08 00}PAU!


{07 0a 00}Ilutulestik on lõpuks
alanud! {01 00 00 0a 00}See müra lihtsalt
karjub {01 00 00 0a 00}{01 08 00}„SUVI!!!” mulle.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}So, we're in the midst of
another {ff 00 00 03}Fireworks Show{ff 00 00 00},
huh?
{07 17 00}Do you have any snacks? {01 00 00 05 00}I'm
suddenly feeling kind of
hungry,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Nii, me oleme jälle keset
{ff 00 00 03}ilutulestikku{ff 00 00 00},
mis?
{07 17 00}Kas sul on näkse? {01 00 00 05 00}Mul
tuli äkki kuidagi
kõht tühjaks,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 04 00}{ff 00 00 04}(GRUMBLE{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.){01 01 00} {ff 00 00 00}Oh, oops!{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 17 00}That
was my belly doing the
rumbling.
{07 14 00}Huh huh!{01 00 00 0a 00} Did you hear it? {01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}I
was hoping all the exploding
fireworks would cover it up.
messages.et:
{07 04 00}{ff 00 00 04}(KORIN{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.){01 01 00} {ff 00 00 00}Oh, ups!{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 17 00}See
oli minu kõht, mis
koises.
{07 14 00}Hah hah!{01 00 00 0a 00} Kuulsid? {01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}Lootsin,
et plahvatav ilutulestik
sumbutab selle ära.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}It's almost time for the
finale,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 02 00}!

{07 0a 00}They launch it with a BOOM,
and the night sky lights up
like it's daytime!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Peagi on finaali aeg,{01 00 00 05 00}
{04 02 00}!

{07 0a 00}Nad lasevad selle PAUGUGA
õhku ja öötaevas läheb
valgeks nagu päeval!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}I guess the fireworks{01 00 00 0a 00} are
almost over{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 16 00}It's kind of
sad really.
{07 14 00}But when the fireworks are
all done, I kinda like that
lingering smell of smoke.
{07 0d 00}It reminds me of toasting
marshmallows!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Vist on ilutulestik{01 00 00 0a 00}
peaaegu läbi{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 16 00}See on
kuidagi kurb.
{07 14 00}Aga kui ilutulestik on
läbi, meeldib mulle see
suitsulõhn, mis jääb.
{07 0d 00}See meenutab mulle
vahukommide röstimist!

messages.en:
{07 0a 00}Whoa!{01 00 00 14 00} It's been a whole year
since the last time I saw
fireworks!
{07 0d 00}And what do you know!{01 00 00 0a 00}
They're still just as fun,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 0a 00}Ohoo!{01 00 00 14 00} Terve aasta on
möödunud, kui viimati
ilutulestikku nägin!
{07 0d 00}Ja mis sa arvad!{01 00 00 0a 00}
See on ikka sama lõbus,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Why are fireworks so
bright and loud? {01 00 00 0a 00}You know,
if they were clothes{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 06 00}Fashion Lad would never
approve of such gaudiness!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Miks on ilutulestik nii
hele ja vali? {01 00 00 0a 00}Tead,
kui see oleks riietus{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 06 00}Moepoiss ei kiidaks sellist
kirevust kunagi heaks!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Hey,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 1f 00}?{01 00 00 0a 00} Have you
noticed that fireworks look
round from every angle?
{07 0a 00}I can totally identify,{01 00 00 05 00}
{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Hei,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 1f 00}?{01 00 00 0a 00} Kas oled
märganud, et ilutulestik
näeb igast nurgast ümar?
{07 0a 00}Ma saan täiesti aru,{01 00 00 05 00}
{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 13 00}People who make fireworks
for a living are sooo cool.

{07 00 00}Being able to make flowers
bloom in the night sky is
so neat!
{07 0a 00}That's one more thing for
my To-Do List,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 13 00}Inimesed, kes teenivad
ilutulestikuga elatist,
on nii lahedad.
{07 00 00}Osata panna lilli õitsema
öötaevas on nii äge!

{07 0a 00}See on veel üks asi mu
teha-nimekirjas,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Hey,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 1f 00}, don't you
agree that fireworks are
totally amazing?
{07 00 00}I mean,{01 00 00 0a 00} I'm here, you're
here, and {04 0b 00} is
here, too.
{07 13 00}And we're all here watching
fireworks together at the
same time!
{07 14 00}In fact, who knows how many
towns are watching
fireworks right now!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Hei,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 1f 00}, kas sa ei
nõustu, et ilutulestik on
täiesti hämmastav?
{07 00 00}Tähendab,{01 00 00 0a 00} mina olen siin,
sina oled siin ja {04 0b 00}
on ka siin.
{07 13 00}Ja me kõik vaatame koos
ilutulestikku samal
ajal!
{07 14 00}Tegelikult, kes teab, kui
mitu linna vaatab praegu
ilutulestikku!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}Oh, no! This year's
fireworks are over! {01 01 00}It's SO
sad, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Oh ei! Selle aasta
ilutulestik on läbi! {01 01 00}NII
kurb, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Huh?{01 00 00 0a 00} Today is the last day
of the fireworks season?!{01 00 00 05 00}
Oh, {04 02 00}!
{07 06 00}Nooooo!{01 00 00 05 00} I don't wanna hear
that! {01 00 00 05 00}Does that mean no
more ice cream, too?!
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Ah?{01 00 00 0a 00} Täna on ilutulestiku
hooaja viimane päev?!{01 00 00 05 00}
Oh, {04 02 00}!
{07 06 00}Eiiii!{01 00 00 05 00} Ma ei taha seda
kuulda! {01 00 00 05 00}Kas see tähendab,
et jäätist ka enam pole?!
